props.caption: The Java Sea search is still a count of rescue and absence, not a settled manifest.
The reported vessel incident was near the Strait of Hormuz traffic gate.
A Normandy TER derailment drew competing public descriptions before a prosecutor's statement said the evidence did not yet support calling it malicious or an attack.

items.note: Basarnas says 103 people were taken off KM Virgo Transport 8 while Reuters separately reported 243 people missing.
One commercial hull was reported struck and one person dead, while the observed crossing count still matched the month-to-date pace.
The prosecutor said the available record did not yet support calling the Normandy derailment malicious or an attack.
The forecast is a 46 percent call on whether Kristersson's side can turn Sweden Democrat support into cabinet authority by 18 September.
Survivors described two explosions on MV June Aster, but investigators still cannot reach the flooded lower decks and engine room.
German direct investment in China rose to about EUR5.6 billion in H1 2026, roughly one-third above the comparable 2025 period.

lead.what: KM Virgo Transport 8 has 103 people taken off in one official count, while a separate missing count remains too unsettled for clean subtraction.

rest.what: The strike report has one death, but a cited monitor still showed 19 crossings in 24 hours against a 19.1/day month-to-date average.

lead.what: Normandy's prosecutor has not adopted the attack label that political figures had already used.

rest.what: The Sweden call sits at 46 percent, with Foreman dissenting at 54 percent on the right-bloc cabinet-authority path.

lead.what: The June Aster inquiry has survivor explosion accounts but not access to the flooded spaces that could settle the mechanism.

rest.what: German firms' China direct investment is about EUR5.6 billion for H1, roughly one-third above the comparable 2025 period.
